answers.reason: The senate decides on overall university statutes and strategy, which is not the faculty administrative officer's specific place.
The budget planning round handles university-wide funds, not the specific matters of the faculty administrative officer.
Appointment committees select professorship candidates, which is outside the faculty administrative officer's designated matters.
The faculty council handles faculty affairs, but the faculty administrative officer organizes examinations rather than sitting on the council.
The study commission prepares degree programme changes, which is not the duty of the faculty administrative officer.
The faculty administrative officer organizes examinations and takes part where examination matters are decided.
Internal research funding is for research projects, not the domain of the faculty administrative officer.
Module revision working groups rewrite module descriptions, which is not the faculty administrative officer's function.
Laboratory equipment procurement is unrelated to the faculty administrative officer's duties.
Orientation week planning is for new student programmes, not the faculty administrative officer's matters.
